reason: The build passes basic verification and is feature-complete, but there are critical integration and edge-case issues (stdout JSON default, population size validation, small-world rewiring bug, plotting guard) that should be fixed before concluding. With two iterations remaining, one focused iteration can address these and add low-risk realism improvements (situational masking, norms EMA), significantly improving robustness and face validity.

specific_areas: Make JSON to stdout the default; add --no-stdout flag and keep optional file outputs
Guard visualization behind an opt-in --plot flag (default off)
Validate and clamp population_size >= 1 and safe initial adoption seeding
Fix ring_small_world rewiring to avoid degree loss; always attempt rewiring or restore edge
Add situational masking under enforcement without flipping long-term adoption state
Smooth norms/media effects via EMA to reduce volatility
Add regression tests: stdout JSON present by default; population_size=0; dense graph rewiring preserves degree; headless run does not plot
Update CLI help/docs and changelog to reflect new flags and defaults

task_understanding.adjustments: Prioritize integration contract compliance (stdout JSON by default, non-interactive defaults) over new features; treat these as release-blocking.

data_analysis.adjustments: Introduce lightweight sanity checks on outputs (e.g., JSON schema validation, expected ranges for adoption/compliance) since real-world calibration is not available yet.

model_planning.adjustments: Limit next changes to low-risk realism upgrades (situational masking, norms EMA) with clear acceptance criteria; defer larger structural changes to future work.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement minimal, targeted patches per prioritized actions; ensure backward-compatible CLI with new suppress/plot flags; keep changes localized and well-commented.

code_verification.adjustments: Add unit/integration tests for edge cases (population_size<=0, dense rewiring), enforce no-GUI in headless mode, and verify stdout JSON emission by default.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Default to deterministic runs with fixed seeds in tests; ensure plotting is disabled unless --plot is set; keep logs on stderr and JSON on stdout.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Add regression assertions: adoption increases with high base_success; compliance increases under enforcement; verify EMA stabilizes norms time series variance.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide a concise changelog, list of fixed critical issues, and guidance for harness usage (flags, outputs); include code diff locations for quick review.
